rules.founder_energy: a founder starts with r^2 energy (half its body's 2r^2); vacuoles start empty
rules.how: act (catalog, report, submit_genome, release, observe), then call end_turn; it returns when the next window opens, with the scoreboard. step and subscribe are refused.
rules.score: your biomass (sum of radius^2 over your living organisms BORN IN THE POOL; founders you release do not count, only their descendants) averaged over every tick of the match. Every tick counts the same, and only lineages that eat and reproduce score.

world.description: Vents wander about 0.25 units a tick. Sitting still starves; trackers win.
world.name: drift
